messages:
toni (design): Quick idea: move sim legend from floating top bar to a slim left rail. Less occlusion when inspecting long rules.

kai (pm): Left rail seems cleaner. Concern about small laptops — can we collapse it?

julie (frontend): Collapsible yes. I'll add a keyboard toggle and `aria-expanded`. Also make it responsive -> bottom drawer on mobile.

omar (a11y): Good. Requirements: legend must have role="region" and accessible name. Don't use color alone for priority; include numeric or textual label.

toni (design): Copy question: "Priority: High" vs "High priority" in compact badges?

kai (pm): "High priority" scans faster in a list. Keep badges short.

julie (frontend): For validation during simulation: inline messages under rule > toasts. Easier to correlate.

omar (a11y): Use `aria-describedby` from rule to message. Debounce live announcements (800ms) so screen readers don't flood.

toni (design): Drag handle visibility: tests show hover-only is missed. Proposal: always-visible small handle in compact mode.

julie (frontend): Implement micro-handle 24px, restrict pointer-events to handle. On touch, use long-press to reorder.

kai (pm): Also show a global summary toast after sim run: "2 warnings, 1 error". Keep it aria-atomic.

omar (a11y): Agree, and ensure toast isn't the only way to learn about errors. Inline + toast is best.

toni (design): I'll update the mock and add compact/mobile variants. Prototype link posted.

julie (frontend): Action: branch `feat/sim-rail` with collapse, keyboard nav, inline validation.

omar (a11y): Action: I'll post an a11y checklist and contrast specs.

kai (pm): Action: I'll finalize badge copy to "High priority" and short tooltips. Ship behind flag.
